outcome: final disposition of claims (paid claims or closed claims)
cohort: The study included 227 legal prosecutions initiated by patients or their families related to delivery complications presented to the Iranian Medical Legal Organization from March 2018 to February 2020.
finding: The study found that maternal complications were more common in caesarean sections, while neonatal claims were more prevalent in vaginal deliveries, with 41.9% of all claims resulting in financial settlements.
